description: This file is a JavaScript module that defines a web scraper function for extracting recipe data from thepioneerwoman.com food recipes. It uses 'request' for HTTP requests and 'cheerio' for HTML parsing, and exports a function that returns a Promise resolving to a recipe object.

methods.name: thePioneerWoman
methods.description: Main function that takes a URL, fetches the webpage, and extracts recipe details into a RecipeSchema object.
